title: Pre-Analysis Review — Extension of the Thickened Flap Carriage Bearing Land to the Shorter Airframe

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Closed review of the in-production bearing land standard, raised to decide whether the thicker fitting should be extended beyond the longer airframe and how it sits against the carriage wear trending work already in pre-analysis.

sections.objective: Decide whether the thickened bearing land on the outboard flap carriage support fittings should be extended to the shorter airframe, and establish what the extension would cost in bulletin, repair and manual terms. The work order was raised internally by the wing structures office after two years of production experience showed the fretting rate on the unmodified fitting to be higher than the original read-across predicted on the shorter airframe as well.
sections.findings_summary: Five items were confirmed and the review did not end with an extension. The flap carriage wear trending change already in pre-analysis covers the same carriage, the same pin bore and the same two zones, and it proposes to detect the wear rather than to design it out. Running the two as separate modifications would have produced two fitting standards and two inspection regimes on a fleet that mixes them. The bonded doubler repair on the flap support rib is written for the thin land and its edge distance does not close on the thick one, and the retrofit bulletin is effective on the longer airframe only, so an extension would need a new effectivity statement rather than an amendment.
sections.next_steps: Hand the extension to the carriage wear trending work order so that one modification carries both the fitting standard and the trending logic for the whole fleet. Transfer the repair edge distance finding and the bulletin effectivity work with it. Keep the in-production standard unchanged on the longer airframe in the meantime and take no separate retrofit decision in this work order.

similarity_seeds: fretting at a flap carriage pin bore shortening fitting life
trending of carriage wear from flap drive system data

tasks.title: Search candidate work on the same carriage and pin bore
Check repair schemes written for the thin land
Assess the effectivity change an extension would need

evidence.similarity_note: Both work on the outboard flap carriage and its pin bore, one by thickening the land and one by trending the wear from drive system data. They share the two carriage zones and nothing else.

expected_findings.rationale: Extending the fitting standard while a wear trending change is in pre-analysis on the same carriage would leave the fleet with two fitting standards and two inspection regimes decided by different work orders. The trending logic also assumes a wear rate measured on the thin land.
expected_findings.resolution: Extension handed to the trending work order so that one modification carries the fitting standard and the trending logic together.

expected_findings.rationale: The bonded doubler repair for a web crack is dimensioned from the thin land and its edge distance does not close against the thicker fitting. Aircraft carrying the repair cannot take the thicker item without a re-analysis of the repair.
expected_findings.resolution: Repair re-analysis transferred with the extension; the repair drawing is annotated pre-mod in the meantime.

expected_findings.rationale: The retrofit bulletin is effective on the longer airframe only and its accomplishment instructions quote the carriage geometry of that airframe. An extension cannot be carried by an amendment; it needs a second effectivity block and a second manpower estimate.
expected_findings.resolution: Effectivity work transferred to the trending work order rather than started here.

expected_findings.rationale: The borescope inspection of the pin bore quotes wear limits taken from the thin land. On the thick land the same absolute wear leaves more material, so the limit is conservative rather than wrong, but the task cannot stay silent about which fitting it is written for.
expected_findings.resolution: Limit table split by fitting standard when the extension is worked.

expected_findings.rationale: The trailing edge harness runs through both carriage zones and its support spacing is dimensioned from the carriage fitting face. The thicker land moves that face by three millimetres, which is inside the support slot but worth recording.
expected_findings.resolution: Noted for the trending work order; no wiring change identified.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares both carriage zones and reads as flap system work, but it is a computer test standard and a torque limiter setting with no structural content, and the fitting change does not alter the drive loads it is rated against.

type_data.conclusion: Delegated. The extension is sound but belongs with the carriage wear trending modification rather than as a second work order on the released fitting standard.
